findings.title: New diagnostics are reported by the source generator, not the analyzer, against the repo's convention
findings.claim: MsgPack019-022 are declared in MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer and listed in its SupportedDiagnostics, but the analyzer never reports them. They are only reported by a separate generator pipeline. The generator also reuses analyzer descriptors (MsgPack004, MsgPack005, MsgPack010) for surrogate errors. The existing design deliberately keeps diagnostics out of the generator ('null when running in the context of a source generator so as to avoid duplicate diagnostics'). Generator diagnostics do not take part in analyzer configuration and run on every generator pass.

evidence.quote: context.RegisterSourceOutput(generatedFormatterDiagnostics, static (context, diagnostic) => context.ReportDiagnostic(diagnostic));
SurrogateMemberNotFound);
This will be <see langword="null" /> when running in the context of a source generator so as to avoid duplicate diagnostics.

findings.suggested_fix: Report MsgPack019-022 from MsgPack00xMessagePackAnalyzer (e.g. a symbol action on classes carrying the attribute that calls GeneratedFormatterCollector.Collect with the analyzer's report callback), and pass null from the generator.

findings.title: Contractless mode ignores any serialization attributes already on the formatted type
findings.claim: Without a surrogate, members are chosen only by 'public read-write' and sorted by name. [IgnoreMember], [IgnoreDataMember], [DataMember]/[Key] and [MessagePackObject] on T are never consulted. The maintainer's direction in the issue was to use attributes if present and fall back to contractless otherwise. For a referenced type that does carry such attributes, the generated wire contract can differ from what the dynamic resolver produces for the same type.

evidence.quote: List<ISymbol> targets = GetInstanceMembers(type).Where(IsPublicReadWrite).OrderBy(m => m.Name, StringComparer.Ordinal).ToList();
By default the formatter serializes the type in *contractless* mode
If there are attributes on it, fine, we'll use them.
evidence.note: issue text cannot be verified offline (not counted as evidence)

findings.suggested_fix: Either honour existing contract attributes (at least the ignore attributes) or emit a diagnostic when T carries MessagePack/DataContract attributes that will be ignored.

findings.title: Successful path has no generator-level test
findings.claim: All 6 new SourceGenerator.Tests are negative diagnostic tests that hand-write the formatter members. No test snapshots or compiles the generated 'partial class' formatter body and resolver registration. The successful path is only covered by the ExecutionTests project (which also adds a new ExternalTypes project and edits MapModeExecutionTests to exclude the files).

findings.suggested_fix: Add a VerifyCS snapshot test for a contractless class, a struct and a surrogate case, so generated output is checked by the fast test suite.
